propositions: Pandoc subprocess invocations hang indefinitely under pathological input because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not CPU-spinning grandchildren
Pandoc binary provenance and GPL license must be recorded and pinned because pandoc 3.6.1 is bundled in pypandoc-binary wheel and GPL compliance requires documentation
Each unit must degrade to original Markdown on timeout or non-zero exit without raising, preserving per-unit fallback semantics and keeping rendered output byte-identical to landed renderer

Caller-side wall-clock timeout via communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) with process group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group must replace subprocess.run to kill entire process group on TimeoutExpired
Config key reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s (default 10s) must be reachable from config file, environment, and documentation across schema, sources, golden config, and docs
Safe-run batching optimization was measured but descoped because 46% of runs are single-unit, batching yields only 12% spawn reduction, and output diverges on 12% of corpus bodies
